revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 12.4% (716,924/637,959); fade gradually toward maturity as the base gets larger; AWS and advertising mix supports above-GDP growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 11.2% (79,975/716,924), FY2024 10.8%; modest expansion from AWS/ads mix, partly offset by heavy depreciation from the capex build.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: blended effective rate below the 21% US statutory rate because of credits and foreign mix; not taken from a filing, reviewer should verify against the 10-K tax note.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A was 9.2% of revenue (65,756/716,924), rising from 8.5% in FY2023 as capex is depreciated.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex was 18.4% of revenue (131,819/716,924), a peak AI/data-center build; assume it normalizes to 15% over the horizon, still above D&A for growth.

wacc.source: CAPM assumption: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta 1.2 (assumed; not pulled from Damodaran industry data) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = about 10.2% cost of equity. Debt is about 68.9B against a market cap in the trillions (market cap not retrieved), so the weighting is almost all equity. Pre-tax cost of debt about 5.1% (assumed). WACC rounded to 9.8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt, 10-K acc. 0001018724-26-000004: total debt 68,851 (LT debt noncurrent 65,648 + current 2,748 + short-term borrowings 455) - cash 86,810 - marketable securities 36,219; negative means net cash
